title: Disability Employment Law Expert Shares Success Story and New Tool
discussion_signal: A first-person workplace account describes requesting accommodations, then facing a performance-improvement process, medical scrutiny, and contested leave. The discussion makes practical control visible: formal rights can still depend on documentation, employer interpretation, and the worker's ability to persist through an adversarial process.
linked_research_question: When workers request changes to make work usable, who controls whether the request becomes a durable workplace adjustment?
limits: Self-reported account and incomplete employment context
Legal claims are not adjudicated evidence
One case cannot estimate accommodation success rates
